images.alt: Two panels both showing an image of new zealand. The one on the left shows various observed temperatures at 7am this morning, the one on the right is a night microphysics satellite image taken at 7am this morning. Various cloud features are pointed out including a large frontal cloud band lurking to the left of the satellite image.

post.text:
🌦️ After a few very cold nights, the frost is out and rain is in ❄️

📈 Temperatures are much warmer this morning, with frosts quite a bit harder to find. They still lurk in a few places, with most of the coldest places in the country in the North Island where skies are a bit clearer.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
